Row1.Rationale: KRAS mutations, including G12C, lead to upregulation of the Ras signaling pathway in lung cancer. Adagrasib targets KRAS G12C, making tumors with this mutation sensitive to the drug.
Row1.llm_reasoning: WP_RAS_SIGNALING is a direct and biologically accurate match for KEGG hsa04014 Ras signaling pathway. The rationale centers on KRAS G12C-driven activation of Ras signaling in lung cancer, which is exactly captured by a generic Ras signaling pathway. Although HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP reflects downstream transcriptional consequences of KRAS activation, it is not an equally direct replacement for the pathway itself, so no correction is needed.

Row2.Rationale: The MAPK (RAF–MEK–ERK) signaling pathway is upregulated in baseline KRAS-mutant lung cancer, contributing to resistance. While initial downregulation may sensitize cells, baseline activity is characterized by upregulation leading to resistance.
Row2.llm_reasoning: The current GO term describes negative adaptation of signaling after prolonged stimulation, which is not a good match for the original pathway, a MAPK (RAF–MEK–ERK) signaling pathway that is upregulated in KRAS-mutant lung cancer and contributes to resistance. A higher-priority HALLMARK set captures this biology better: HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP reflects genes up-regulated by KRAS activation and is more directly aligned with baseline KRAS-driven MAPK/ERK pathway activation than a generic negative-adaptation GO term.

Row12.Original Pathway Name: KEGG: hsa05223 – Non‑small cell lung cancer (RTK–RAS–MAPK, PI3K, STK11/KEAP1 modules)
Row12.Rationale: In baseline lung cancer, the RTK–RAS–MAPK and PI3K pathways are often upregulated, particularly in KRAS-mutant tumors. However, co-mutations in STK11/KEAP1 can lead to resistance due to reliance on alternative pathways.
Row12.llm_reasoning: The current mapping is too generic and does not specifically represent KEGG hsa05223 non-small cell lung cancer or its core RTK-RAS-MAPK, PI3K, STK11/KEAP1 modules. Among the candidates, WP_NONSMALL_CELL_LUNG_CANCER is the closest direct semantic match to the original pathway. HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP captures one important component of the biology, but it is narrower than the full KEGG pathway and therefore not as appropriate as a disease-specific lung cancer pathway.
